parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Surrey · Cloverdale

Clayton is the part of Cloverdale along Fraser Highway at the Langley border. The City says East Clayton started as rural acreage and farmland and is now home to over 15,000 Surrey residents. Most homes are newer houses, townhomes and condos, and two SkyTrain stations are being built along Fraser Highway.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 13, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Surrey and Surrey Schools.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

parts.t: Clayton Heights is one of Surrey's newer communities, known for its family-friendly atmosphere, modern homes, and convenient location. Buyers are drawn to Clayton for its mix of newer detached houses, townhomes, and walkable neighborhoods close to schools, parks, and shopping.

Located near Langley and major commuter routes, Clayton offers easy access to Willowbrook Mall, restaurants, recreation centres, and future SkyTrain expansion plans. The area is especially popular with young families and professionals looking for newer construction, safe streets, and strong long-term value.

Whether you're searching for a starter home, an upgrade into a larger detached property, or an investment opportunity, Clayton Heights continues to be one of the most in-demand real estate markets in Surrey.

blocks.text: What to look at in a Clayton home

parts.t: These are the questions I go through with buyers.
Lot size, the age of the roof, furnace, plumbing and wiring, and drainage
What the zone allows, and whether any suite was built with a permit
Assuming you can add a suite or rebuild just because a neighbour did
Strata fees, the depreciation report (the plan for future repairs), meeting minutes and bylaws
About upcoming special levies (extra one-time charges) and what the fees include

items.t: Pet, rental or age rules that don’t fit your plans

parts.t: Plans are changing around the new SkyTrain stations. Zoning and plan designations can be different for each lot.
East Clayton is split into four plan areas, including a transit-oriented area along Fraser Highway. Together they cover about 314 hectares (776 acres).

The City is writing the Clayton Corridor Plan to guide growth around the two future SkyTrain stations. The draft area runs along Fraser Highway from the edge of the ALR in the west to 192 Street in the east.
The City is also making a new 196 Street Plan for the Surrey side of Willowbrook Station.
Ask the City of Surrey what the Clayton Corridor Plan proposes for the lots around the home, especially near Fraser Highway.
Use the Surrey Schools School Locator for the exact address.
